description: Given a loan's balance, annual rate, and a proposed monthly payment, check whether that payment covers the interest accruing each period. If not, report the shortfall and project how the balance grows instead of shrinking.

annualRatePercent.description: The loan's annual interest rate as a percent

capPercent.description: Optional balance cap as a percent of the original principal (e.g. 110 for a 110% cap)

projectionMonths.description: How many months to project the balance (default 12, max 600)

name: detect_negative_amortization
